Most expect a tight game: projections run 4-3 (iHeart, Bleacher Nation) to 4-2 (CappersPicks), and four of Dallas' last five wins were by one goal. The contrarian view is Dimers' model, which gives Nashville 41.2% and calls the Predators moneyline the value bet; Nashville is 4-1 as a +140-or-longer underdog and won the earlier meeting. Saros vs Oettinger expected, both unconfirmed. Dallas is thin on defense (Bichsel, Capobianco out; Myers day-to-day).
